numinance.kinds.v1.ExportView.jsonschema.description: ExportView is a named selection of a change's evidence for one audience, such as one requirement of the framework.

controls.description: controls is required and non-empty: the ids of the pack's controls whose evidence the view exports, unique.

name.description: name is required: the view's name, as numi evidence export --view takes it.

numinance.kinds.v1.ExportView.jsonschema.title: Export View
